caption:
Explore the free Janam Kundali tool running securely in your browser.

When planning for a rishta, generating a janam kundali should be straightforward and private. RishtaPatra offers three products: biodata maker, Rishta Connect, and Janam Kundali (free). The astrology engine runs directly in the browser; no request carries your birth data.

Kundali note: Calculations are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to get started.
